'''Death wings''' are [[ghost]]ly bat-like creatures encountered in the [[Viyeldi caves]] during and after the [[Legends' Quest]].

They attack with [[melee]] against a player if they are initiating combat, but if the player attacks them first, they will only attack back with [[magic]]. The [[ectoplasmator]] will give a player 4.5 [[Prayer]] experience upon killing them.

To reach them, players should bring one or more [[lockpick]]s, a [[machete]], a [[Hatchets|hatchet]] and a [[pickaxes|pickaxe]] (the tool belt can be used for all except the lockpick, unless the [[Master thief's lockpick]] has been added to the tool belt). The dungeon can be found in the north-west of the [[Kharazi Jungle]] by searching the mossy rocks, after which the player should search the bookshelf north of [[Ungadulu]] and choose to squeeze through there, picklock the ancient door, mine the rocks and open another door to reach the Death wings. Death wings can also sometimes be found inside [[Barrel (Viyeldi caves)|barrel]]s in the dungeon.

Despite their bat-like appearance, they cannot be killed for [[Bats (Slayer assignment)|bats Slayer assignment]], instead counting as [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|ghost]] and by extension [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead]].

Killing a death wing is one of the [[hard Karamja achievements]], [[Deadwing]].
